summary: Starting December 2, 2026, GitHub Actions will block pull_request_target events by default in all public repositories, unless an applicable Actions event policy explicitly allows them. Enforcement was previously scheduled for November 2, 2026.
takeaways: GitHub introduced this default rule through workflow execution protections.
The rule initially runs in evaluate mode, so you can see which workflow runs it would block before enforcement begins.
If a workflow executes untrusted code from a fork, that code could compromise your pipeline or steal secrets.
